fullSource:
use default

let doc =
    "Rosetta Code\n"
    "    is a programming chrestomathy site.\n"
    "\n"
    "It preserves:\n"
    "  - indentation\n"
    "  - line breaks\n"
    "  - other whitespace\n"
    "within a block built from adjacent string literals."

write_line(doc)
output:
Rosetta Code
    is a programming chrestomathy site.

It preserves:
  - indentation
  - line breaks
  - other whitespace
within a block built from adjacent string literals.
